title: Domestic progress after a clear transition

captions.physics: Ending outdated domestic methods and participation
captions.energy: Leaving new arrangements in prolonged waiting

meaning: Your domestic support sustains movement when an ending gains clear continuation instead of leaving both indefinitely awaiting final new arrangements.
text: You can finish a domestic task that has lost its purpose and change the form of participation. Death in the physical position of Muladhara describes this ending. The Hanged Man in energy complicates it through prolonged waiting. The Chariot in emotions wants tangible progress together. Transition can stop after rejection: the old is gone while the new cannot yet be used. Both await a complete answer instead of an available step although present life needs understandable temporary support to reveal the benefit of change already accepted.

For example, you remove an inconvenient shoe shelf. Its space stays occupied by bags until a final replacement is chosen, leaving the hallway no freer. **Progress needs available continuation after the previous form ends.** You can name temporary storage and clear the passage. Transition lets both use a result instead of merely confirming readiness to abandon the old while keeping present domestic life waiting for a future form not yet found in its entirety.

The difficulty is considering a temporary answer unworthy of genuine change. Waiting preserves inconvenience in another shape. Distinguishing a first step from final arrangements offers more dependable support: their scale need not match. An ending reveals actual benefit now without making every domestic result depend on every open question of transition disappearing completely. A provisional arrangement can honour the change rather than undermine it.
